verdict.rationale: Postmark has no native automation or workflow builder. What it offers are event-driven building blocks: real-time webhooks for delivery and bounce events, and inbound email parsing posted to your endpoint, with an inbound retry API. These let users build background automations, but the logic must be written and hosted by the user, with webhook handler examples given as the starting point. Missing for 10: a first-party automation/workflow or scheduling feature, autonomous agent-driven background tasks, and independent hands-on evidence of automation use.
